sn35.146:1.1: desessāmi kammanirodhaṁ → desissāmi kammanirodhañca (bj, sya-all); desissāmi kammanirodham (pts)

sn35.146:1.5: purāṇakammā → purāṇaṁ kammaṁ (bj); purāṇakammam (pts) | purāṇakammam → B1 -kammā (pts note)
